name: 反怒的熊猫
desc: 对方场上的怪兽每有1只这张卡的攻击力上升500。向守备表示怪兽攻击时，若攻击力超过那个守备力，给与对方那个数值的战斗伤害。
faq: When "Gyaku-Gire Panda" is equipped with "Rod of the Mind's Eye" and attacks, the Battle Damage is 1000 points.
ruling: "Gyaku-Gire Panda” constantly checks the number of monsters on the opponent’s fi eld and modifi es its ATK value accordingly.
